title: Model of Things (MoT): A Model-Driven Approach to Streamline Cloud-of-Things Application Development
abstract: arXiv:2512.14613v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The convergence of Cloud Computing and the Internet of Things (IoT) underpins modern, scalable, and data-intensive systems. Cloud-of-Things (CoT) applications are now pervasive across healthcare, smart cities, and industrial automation. Nevertheless, their development remains fragmented and technically demanding. Current CoT development approaches require substantial expertise in heterogeneous platforms, protocols, and deployment technologies. They offer limited model-driven support, weak automation, and poor alignment with low-code principles. As a result, developing CoT applications remains effort-intensive and error-prone. This study aims to simplify CoT application development by introducing the Model of Things (MoT). MoT integrates UML-based modeling with low-code execution concepts to reduce technical barriers while preserving automation and deployment feasibility. translated_title: 万物模型：一种简化万物云应用开发的模型驱动方法
translated_abstract: 云计算与物联网的融合是现代可扩展、数据密集型系统的基础。万物云应用如今已普遍应用于医疗保健、智慧城市和工业自动化等领域。然而，其开发过程仍然碎片化且技术要求高。当前的CoT开发方法需要对异构平台、协议和部署技术具备大量专业知识，其提供的模型驱动支持有限、自动化程度弱，且与低代码原则的契合度不佳。因此，开发CoT应用仍然费时费力且容易出错。本研究旨在通过引入万物模型来简化CoT应用开发。MoT将基于UML的建模与低代码执行概念相结合，在保持自动化和部署可行性的同时降低技术门槛。我们设计了一个包含九个CoT特定构造型（stereotypes）的自定义UML profile……
tldr: 本文提出了万物模型（MoT），一种将基于UML的建模与低代码执行概念相结合的模型驱动方法，旨在降低技术门槛、简化万物云应用的开发。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Model of Things (MoT), a model-driven approach that integrates UML-based modeling with low-code execution concepts to reduce technical barriers and streamline Cloud-of-Things application development.
